question: Which of the following cricketers clinched the record for the fastest century by an Indian woman cricketer in ODIs, as of January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smriti Mandhana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Smriti Mandhana** holds the record for the **fastest century by an Indian woman cricketer** in One Day Internationals (ODIs) as of **January 2025**.
 
• She achieved this remarkable feat against **New Zealand** in a match held on **February 7, 2019**. Smriti scored her century in just **57 balls**, showcasing her extraordinary batting skills.
 
• This achievement placed her among the elite women cricketers globally, as she became one of the fastest century-makers in the history of women’s ODI cricket.
 
• Smriti Mandhana has consistently been a key player for the Indian Women’s Cricket Team and is known for her aggressive batting style and ability to anchor innings effectively.
 
• Her record-breaking century reflects her ability to adapt to different formats of the game and perform under pressure, solidifying her status as one of the best female cricketers in the world.
